## Multidimensional Financial Wellbeing Scale {#tool1}

**Description:** Comprehensive assessment of financial wellbeing dimensions.

-   **Purpose:** To measure multidimensional structure of financial wellbeing among emerging adults.
-   **Population:** Emerging adults
-   **Items:** 5 sub-dimensions, 25 items
-   **Language(s):** English, Turkish
-   **Citation:** Your Name et al. (2025).
